info.name: SkillMetrix LMS - Full API Test Suite
info.description:
Comprehensive test suite for SkillMetrix LMS API.

**How to use:**
1. Import this collection into Postman
2. Run requests in order (top to bottom) — they chain data automatically
3. Or use Postman Runner to run the entire collection

**Flow:** Seed → Auth → Courses → Chapters → Lessons → Enrollments → Progress → Transactions → Cleanup
